title: Santa is Missing D&D one shot
seo_title: Santa Is Missing D&D One-Shot in Joplin, MO
description: Santa Is Missing! is a holiday-themed D&D one-shot set at the North Pole, where your party is hired by the Elves to track down Santa and bring him back before time runs out. Tickets are $10 per person and include hot cider or hot chocolate, freshly baked cookies, and a new dice set to keep; seats are limited and RSVP is needed. It takes place December 12, 2026 (Time TBD) at 2002 S Tyler Ave. in Joplin, MO.
